title: Upcoming deprecation of the data quality monitoring downstream_impact column
body:
The `downstream_impact` column in the data quality monitoring results system table is being deprecated.

Deprecation begins September 7, 2026, and rolls out gradually across regions over the following week. Until the rollout reaches your workspace, you might still be able to query `downstream_impact`. After deprecation completes, the column is no longer populated.

For the affected column, see [Data quality monitoring results system table reference](/aws/en/admin/system-tables/data-quality-monitoring) and [Review anomaly detection logged results](/aws/en/data-governance/unity-catalog/data-quality-monitoring/anomaly-detection/results).
